summary: Mollies lookout, Kaniksu National Forest: L-4 cab built 1934, abandoned 1949, destroyed 1968; concrete footings remain at a hike-in summit per a 2018 guide.

facts.design: L-4 cab built atop the peak
facts.status_note: Cab destroyed in 1968; a 2018 hike guide describes concrete footings at the summit

access.note: Hike-in summit reached by a trail described in a September 2018 hike guide, which mentions no closure or permit; not checked against current Forest Service notices

visit.trail_note: About 3.9 miles round trip with about 1,800 feet of gain from a trailhead off FS 46. The guide rates it difficult, warns that the forest road is rough, and makes the footings the turnaround point.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page lists Ernest Grambo for 1932, which is earlier than the 1934 cab date on the same page. The story reports the entry as listed and does not explain it.

sources.title: Cabin Architecture

notes_for_editor: Core dates (1934 build, 1949 abandonment, 1968 destruction) agree across three pages. The only conflict is the 1932 staff entry, which predates the cab on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page. The access note relies on a September 2018 hike guide and is not checked against current conditions. The brief's kind ground matches the Forest Fire Lookout Association list; no correction proposed.
